exact_abs_tol_meaning: Inherited numerical equality from r41.structure.v1. It is not a pip band and it was not searched.
swing_rules: Unchanged r41.structure.v1 confirmation, ties, gaps, and relations.
line_construction: Unchanged consecutive same-type swings and elapsed-UTC slope.
pairing: The latest ACTIVE support and the latest ACTIVE resistance. Support must be strictly below resistance. Same-timestamp swings are applied in pivot time then swing-type order, HIGH before LOW, and the pair is evaluated once after those births.
stale_meaning: No age threshold. A level is ineligible when it is INVALIDATED or SUPERSEDED. That is the only meaning of stale.
crossed_pair: Support price greater than or equal to resistance price yields no candidate. The crossed identity is counted once.
level_birth: A level becomes ACTIVE at the swing confirmation time. The confirmation candle does not invalidate it.
level_invalidation: A later completed close strictly through the price, using the inherited tolerance, sets INVALIDATED. A wick that closes back is not invalidation.
level_supersession: A newer confirmed level of the same kind sets the previous ACTIVE level to SUPERSEDED. INVALIDATED is not rewritten.
same_candle_order: First apply the candle to structures already available. Then birth new swings and lines. A close through an old level on the birth candle of its replacement invalidates the old level. Supersession happens only if it is still ACTIVE.
line_supersession: A newer line of the same kind supersedes the ACTIVE line. A BROKEN line stays BROKEN.
line_break: The first later close beyond the active line. Later candles are not extra breaks. A broken line is not reactivated and is not evaluated again.
touch_episode: The first candle of an uninterrupted reach. Adjacent reaches are the same episode. A non-reach candle ends it. The original pivot and the confirmation candle are not reactions.
range_reactions: The same reach rule, counted only for an episode that starts after the pair exists. Episodes that began earlier do not count. Two support episodes and two resistance episodes confirm the candidate. Consecutive reaches are one episode.
range_states: UNCERTAIN, CANDIDATE, CONFIRMED, INVALIDATED. A pair alone is CANDIDATE. Confirmation is the candle that completes the second episode on the lagging side. A close outside before or after confirmation is INVALIDATED. A newer eligible pair replaces the old one without rewriting it into a price invalidation.
active_only_evaluation: Only the current level of each kind and the current line of each kind are compared with new candles. Archived versions stay in the record and are not scanned again.
legacy_continuation: Not computed. The distinct-event count does not include raw retained-line comparisons.
prefix_cut_role: Causality check only. It is not a market threshold.
